title: Three Men, a Cave, and a Boulder

captions.tiktok: A boulder sealed three men inside a cave. Their only key was the good deeds nobody ever saw. Sahih al-Bukhari 2272.
captions.shorts: Three men trapped in a cave, and the deeds that moved the boulder. Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.
captions.reels: A boulder sealed three men inside a cave. Their only key was the good deeds nobody ever saw. Sahih al-Bukhari 2272.

segments.text: Three travelers took shelter in a cave for the night. And while they slept... a boulder broke loose from the mountain, rolled down, and sealed the entrance shut.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, told what happened inside that cave.
segments.title: THE SEALED CAVE
segments.titleSub: a story told by the Prophet, peace be upon him

segments.text: No one knew where they were. No strength could shift the rock. And in the dark, they said to one another... nothing can save you from this... except calling on Allah by the most righteous deed you have ever done.

The first man spoke of his mother and father, grown old. Every night he brought them milk before anyone else... before his own children. One evening they were asleep, and he would not wake them, and would not serve anyone first. So he stood... the bowl in his hand... until dawn.
O Allah, he said... if I did that seeking Your face, relieve us. And the rock shifted. A little. A sliver of sky... not enough to escape.

The second man had loved his cousin... the deepest love a man can have for a woman, he said. She refused him. Then came a year of famine, and she had nothing. He offered her a hundred and twenty gold coins... for a night. And she, desperate, agreed.

But when he sat before her, she said... it is not lawful for you to break the seal, except by its right. And he stood up, and walked away... from the woman he loved most in the world. And he left her the gold. O Allah, if I did that seeking Your face... relieve us. The rock moved again. Still not enough.

The third man had once hired a laborer who left before collecting his wage. So the man invested it... for years... until it had grown into camels, cows, sheep. When the laborer finally returned, expecting a coin, the man pointed at the herds filling the valley. All of it is yours. And he drove every animal away, and left nothing.
O Allah... if I did that seeking Your face, relieve us of what we are in. And the boulder rolled clear of the entrance... and the three of them walked out.

Notice what unlocked the mountain. Not their prayers in public. Three private moments... a bowl held till dawn, a desire refused, a debt honored beyond reason. Somewhere in your past there may be a deed like that. Guard it. One day it may be the only key you have.
